metadata.description: bracyw's Claude Code mods: audited copies of upstream mods, and original ones. Upstream updates are pulled in only after review.

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: IDE-style file tree with git status that highlights files Claude reads and edits. Copy of data-goblin/claude-code-filetree@b0e4098 (MIT).

plugins.name: cache-tax
plugins.description: Prompt-cache guard: warns before a cold send and can keep the 1h cache warm. Copy of karanb192/cache-tax@06cac47 (MIT).

plugins.name: convo-tree
plugins.description: Maps the conversation into branches: a pane of branch cards, a live browser map with click-to-switch, and subagents that see one branch. Written here, not a copy.
